name: Google Workspace AI (Gemini)
pricing_tiers: Google AI Plus: $7.99/month (consumer). Google AI Pro: $19.99/month. Google AI Ultra: $99.99/month (reduced from $249.99 at I/O 2026). Gemini for Workspace Business: $20/user/month. Gemini for Workspace Enterprise: $30/user/month. Google Workspace plans start at $7.20/user/month (Business Starter) with Gemini add-ons available.
free_tier_available: yes — Google AI Free tier (basic Gemini access); Gemini features partially included in Google Workspace at no extra cost for qualifying plans
latest_major_release: May 2026: Google I/O — Gemini 3.5 Flash launched ($1.50/M input tokens), Ultra pricing cut 60%, Google AI subscriptions restructured
key_capabilities: email drafting/summarization (Gmail), document generation (Docs), data analysis (Sheets), meeting notes/summaries (Meet), presentation creation (Slides), AI-powered search across Drive/Gmail, image generation (Imagen), Gemini side panel across all Workspace apps
integrations: native Google Workspace (Gmail, Docs, Sheets, Slides, Meet, Drive, Calendar, Chat); 5,000+ third-party apps via Google Workspace Marketplace; Vertex AI for custom models; BigQuery, Looker for analytics
smb_onboarding_time: minutes to hours (immediate activation for existing Google Workspace customers; admin console toggle)
mobile_support: full mobile apps (iOS/Android) — Gmail, Docs, Sheets, Slides all with Gemini integration; Google app with Gemini Live voice mode
target_company_size: 1-300 (Business), 300+ (Enterprise); Google AI consumer plans serve micro-businesses/solopreneurs
estimated_smb_users: 10 million+ Google Workspace Business customers (Google reported 3B+ Workspace users across all tiers); Gemini AI active in majority of Workspace accounts
market_differentiator: lowest entry price ($7.99/month consumer, $20/user/month business); native Google ecosystem (Search, Maps, YouTube grounding); 1M token context window (Gemini 3.5 Pro); best-in-class multimodal (video, audio, image analysis)
key_competitors: Microsoft Copilot for Business, ChatGPT for Business, Notion AI
typical_roi_claim: Google claims 40% time savings on email/writing tasks; 88% of Gemini users report faster task completion (Google internal survey 2026)
smb_adoption_trend: growing rapidly — Google I/O 2026 restructured pricing to compete with Microsoft Copilot; SMBs on Google Workspace increasingly adopting Gemini add-ons; 82% SMB AI adoption rate
notable_smb_case_studies: Several SMBs report 5-8 hrs/week saved on email and document work; Google Workspace customers using Gemini report 30-50% fewer support tickets via AI-powered help
funding_to_date: Alphabet: $350B annual revenue (2025); Google Cloud revenue $43B; no separate Gemini funding (internal product)
partner_ecosystem: Google Cloud Partner Advantage (50,000+ partners); Workspace reseller network for SMBs; ISV ecosystem via Google Workspace Marketplace; system integrators (Accenture, Deloitte, etc.)
community_support: Google Workspace Admin Help, Google Cloud Community, Google AI Studio (developer playground), Gemini Academy training, extensive YouTube tutorials
